vocab.example_vi: Linh phụ trách ghi biên bản trong mọi cuộc họp phòng ban tháng này.

vocab.meaning_vi: bảng theo dõi việc cần làm
vocab.example: Please check the action log to see who is handling the supplier contract.
vocab.example_vi: Hãy xem bảng theo dõi việc cần làm để biết ai đang xử lý hợp đồng nhà cung cấp.

vocab.example: The chairperson opened the meeting and asked everyone to keep their comments short.
vocab.example_vi: Người chủ trì khai mạc cuộc họp và đề nghị mọi người phát biểu ngắn gọn.

vocab.meaning_vi: diễn đạt lại bằng lời của mình

vocab.example: I will write up my rough notes into proper minutes this afternoon.

vocab.example: The final version of the minutes was saved in the department folder.
vocab.example_vi: Bản cuối cùng của biên bản đã được lưu trong thư mục của phòng.

vocab.example_vi: Ngày đào tạo vẫn còn chờ xác nhận, nên tôi để trống.

listening.title: Linh prepares the minutes after a department meeting

lines.speaker: Minh (Team Leader)
lines.text: Linh, are you taking the minutes for the department meeting this morning?

lines.speaker: Linh (Admin Officer)
lines.text: Yes, I am. I will note down the decisions and who is responsible for each task.

lines.speaker: Minh (Team Leader)
lines.text: Good. Please also write the name of the chairperson and the list of people who joined.

lines.speaker: Linh (Admin Officer)
lines.text: Sure. Should I record every word, or only the main points?

lines.speaker: Minh (Team Leader)
lines.text: Only the main points. You can paraphrase long discussions in one or two sentences.

lines.speaker: Linh (Admin Officer)
lines.text: Understood. I will also update the action log with the new deadlines.

lines.speaker: Minh (Team Leader)
lines.text: Perfect. By the way, the training date for new staff is still to be confirmed.

lines.speaker: Linh (Admin Officer)
lines.text: Then I will mark it as pending and ask HR before I write up the notes.

lines.speaker: Minh (Team Leader)
lines.text: When can you share the draft with the team?

lines.speaker: Linh (Admin Officer)
lines.text: This afternoon. If nobody has corrections, I will send the final version tomorrow morning.

questions.q: What does Minh ask Linh to include in the minutes?
options: The chairperson's name and the attendees
A full recording of the meeting

questions.q: How should Linh handle long discussions?
options: Paraphrase them in one or two sentences

questions.q: Why does Linh mark the training date as pending?
options: Because the date is still to be confirmed
Because HR already sent the schedule
